reason: The README describes a gateway integration that exposes DeepSeek Harness sessions through SlashX request and response protocols, handling authenticated HTTP transport, media exchange, asynchronous callbacks, structured rich responses, artifact delivery, and token metering.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话通过兼容 SlashX 协议的 HTTP 网关对外提供，并支持媒体传输、异步回调、富响应和制品交付。
summaries.en: Exposes DeepSeek Harness sessions through a SlashX-compatible HTTP gateway with media transfer, asynchronous callbacks, rich responses, and artifact delivery.

capabilities: Exposes a SlashX-compatible HTTP gateway for DeepSeek Harness sessions
Accepts authenticated text and media requests, including images, files, audio, and video
Downloads and validates remote media, stores files in session workspaces, and publishes local artifacts through signed URLs
Supports structured responses, asynchronous callbacks, polling, cancellation, and token metering
Maintains persistent run and session state on the filesystem
